report.summary: 5 findings reviewed: 2 high, 2 medium, 1 high (needs-evidence). Plan: fix codex_cli.py None check, add validation in subject_for, disambiguate untracked -1, verify eval_baseline_candidates, find _verify_reachable.
risks: codex_cli.py missing None check leads to TypeError if codex not installed.
subject_for accepts mismatched sha256/payload, corrupting ledger.
untracked -1 ambiguity may cause incorrect decisions in consumers.
eval_baseline_candidates skips tasks based on stale baseline recall.
_verify_reachable may be no-op or missing, breaking containment.
todos: Add None guard after shutil.which('codex') in codex_cli.py.
Add validation in subject_for to reject mismatched sha256/payload.
Disambiguate untracked -1 by using separate sentinel or always probing.
Update eval_baseline_candidates to verify current recall before skipping.
Locate _verify_reachable in worktree.py and ensure it is defined and effective.

items.title: Fix missing None check after shutil.which('codex') in codex_cli.py
items.why_now: High severity: crash if codex not installed, blocking external provider usage.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/providers/codex_cli.py for shutil.which('codex') call and add None check with clear error message.
steps.verified_by: Run test that calls the function without codex installed; expect informative error instead of TypeError.

items.assumption: The finding's narrowing to codex_cli.py is correct; the actual shutil.which call exists and lacks None guard.

items.title: Add validation in subject_for for mismatched sha256/payload
items.why_now: High severity: inconsistent ledger entries if both provided and disagree.

steps.do: Locate subject_for function (likely in daedalus/spine/ledger.py or daedalus/spine/envelope.py) and add check that if both sha256 and payload are provided, sha256 must equal hash of payload.
steps.verified_by: Write test passing both sha256 and payload that disagree; assert ValueError is raised.

items.assumption: subject_for is in spine module; actual file path unknown, file set to UNKNOWN.

items.title: Disambiguate untracked -1 sentinel in mapping/render.py
items.why_now: Medium severity: -1 ambiguous between 'not probed' and 'error'; may cause logic errors in consumers.

steps.do: In daedalus/mapping/render.py, change git_stamp to use a separate sentinel (e.g., None) for 'not probed' and keep -1 for error, or always probe to avoid ambiguity.
steps.verified_by: grep -r 'untracked' daedalus/spine/docref_gate.py daedalus/eval/harness.py; ensure consumers handle both sentinels correctly.

items.assumption: The sentinel ambiguity exists as described; consumers may not distinguish.

items.title: Verify eval_baseline_candidates checks current recall before skipping
items.why_now: Medium severity: stale baseline recall may cause tasks to be incorrectly skipped.

steps.do: Inspect eval_baseline_candidates in daedalus/spine/picker.py; if it uses baseline recall without rechecking, add a current recall check before skipping.
steps.verified_by: Command: grep -A 30 'def eval_baseline_candidates' daedalus/spine/picker.py; review logic.

items.assumption: The function exists and behaves as described; no current recall verification.

items.title: Locate and verify _verify_reachable in worktree.py
items.why_now: High severity: if missing or no-op, containment is ineffective, risking host compromise.

steps.do: Search for 'def _verify_reachable' in daedalus/kairos/worktree.py; if found, ensure it actually validates reachability; if not, implement it.
steps.verified_by: Run existing containment tests; ensure _verify_reachable is called and raises on invalid paths.

items.assumption: The function is either missing or incomplete; need to inspect full file.
